# airs gateway

```text
Manage and observe Prisma AIRS AI Gateway resources

Usage: airs gateway [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  admin-guardrails  Manage organisation guardrails on the admin plane (mutations specification-tested)
  api-keys          Manage service and user gateway credentials
  audit-logs        Inspect organisation audit activity
  configs           Manage routing configurations
  deployments       Manage self-hosted gateway registrations
  guardrails        Manage workspace guardrails
  inference         Call the gateway runtime (separate API key; no SCM OAuth required)
  integrations      Manage organisation provider integrations
  mcp               Manage MCP integrations and servers
  organisations     Manage organisation and authentication settings
  plugins           Manage gateway plugins
  providers         Manage workspace provider bindings
  report            Generate an AI Gateway environment report (read-only) [aliases: dashboard]
  scopes            Manage SCM IAM scopes — the objects a workspace scope_name points at (/iam/v1)
  telemetry         AI Gateway runtime telemetry (data plane)
  workspaces        Manage gateway workspaces [aliases: workspace]
  help              Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --output <format>  Output format: pretty, table, json
      --quiet            Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## airs gateway admin-guardrails

```text
Manage organisation guardrails on the admin plane (mutations specification-tested)

Usage: airs gateway admin-guardrails [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  create       Create an admin guardrail (specification-tested; no workspace fallback)
  delete       Permanently delete an admin guardrail [aliases: rm]
  get          Read an admin guardrail by UUID
  list         List organisation guardrails; optional workspace filtering may be denied by policy [aliases: ls]
  mcp-servers  Manage admin guardrail MCP mappings; does not sign in to MCP
  update       Update an admin guardrail (specification-tested)
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

      --output <format>  Output format: pretty, table, json
      --quiet            Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help
```

```text

Arguments:
  [prompt]  

Options:
      --endpoint <url>   Runtime base URL including /v1; overrides config
      --output <format>  Output format: pretty, table, json; streaming json emits one event per line (JSONL)

      --stream           Stream text (pretty) or validated events (json/JSONL)
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## airs gateway report

```text
Generate an AI Gateway environment report (read-only)

Usage: airs gateway report [OPTIONS] --workspace <ref>

Options:
      --days <n>            Rolling window in days (default: 1)
      --output <format>     Refused by this command: the report is written as HTML (omit --output)
      --end <iso>           Explicit ISO-8601 end; requires --start
      --quiet               Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug               Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --max-pages <n>       Page budget per source, 1–100 (50 transactions/page) (default: "40")
      --output-file <path>  Destination (default: new timestamped file in CWD); - for stdout; never overwrite
      --tenant <name>       Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
      --start <iso>         Explicit ISO-8601 start; requires --end
      --strict              Exit 1 after writing if any source is incomplete
      --title <text>        Report title (default: "AI Gateway environment report")
      --workspace <ref>     Workspace slug, UUID, or unique display name
  -h, --help                Print help

Examples:
  $ airs gateway report --workspace ws-develo-71f8d8 --output-file ./airs-daily.html
  $ airs gateway report --workspace ws-develo-71f8d8
  $ airs gateway report --workspace ws-develo-71f8d8 --strict --max-pages 20 --output-file - > daily.html
```

      --metadata <json>        Filter by string-valued metadata (JSON object)
      --status-codes <codes>   Comma-separated HTTP statuses (OR within the list)
      --total-units-max <n>    Inclusive maximum total tokens (nonnegative integer)
      --total-units-min <n>    Inclusive minimum total tokens (nonnegative integer)
      --trace-id <id>          Filter by one trace ID

## airs gateway workspaces

```text
Manage gateway workspaces

Usage: airs gateway workspaces [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  archive  Archive a workspace (soft delete — there is no hard delete)
  create   Create a workspace: IAM scope → workspace → bind scope (admin plane)
  get      Get one workspace by UUID or slug (includes settings blocks)
  list     List workspaces (default: active workspaces you are scoped to) [aliases: ls]
  update   Update a workspace (admin plane, partial patch)
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --output <format>  Output format: pretty, table, json
      --quiet            Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help
```

### airs gateway workspaces archive

```text
Archive a workspace (soft delete — there is no hard delete)

Usage: airs gateway workspaces archive [OPTIONS] <ref>

Arguments:
  <ref>  

Options:
      --force            Skip confirmation prompt
      --output <format>  Ignored by this command (it prints no data); must still be one of pretty, table, json
      --quiet            Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help

Examples:
  $ airs gateway workspaces archive ws-produc-985697 --force
```

### airs gateway workspaces create

```text
Create a workspace: IAM scope → workspace → bind scope (admin plane)

Usage: airs gateway workspaces create [OPTIONS] --name <name>

Options:
      --description <text>   Workspace description
      --output <format>      Output format: pretty, table, json
      --existing-scope       Bind an IAM scope that already exists instead of creating one (requires --scope-name)
      --quiet                Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug                Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --icon <icon>          Workspace icon
      --name <name>          Display name
      --tenant <name>        Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
      --scope-name <scope>   IAM scope to create and bind (e.g. ws_production_bx7qw0). Default: ws_<name>_<suffix>
      --users <ids>          Comma-separated user ids to seed the workspace with
      --defaults <json>      Workspace defaults object
      --metadata <json>      Sugar for defaults.metadata (flat string map)
      --rate-limits <json>   Rate-limit policies — a JSON ARRAY of policy objects
      --usage-limits <json>  Usage-limit policies — a JSON ARRAY of policy objects
  -h, --help                 Print help

Examples:
  $ airs gateway workspaces create --name truffles --description "Online recipe generation application"
  $ airs gateway workspaces create --name Production --scope-name ws_production_bx7qw0
  $ airs gateway workspaces create --name Staging --scope-name ws_staging_q1x8mz --existing-scope
  $ airs gateway workspaces create --name Production --metadata '{"env":"production"}' --rate-limits '[{"type":"requests","unit":"rpm","value":100}]'
```

### airs gateway workspaces get

```text
Get one workspace by UUID or slug (includes settings blocks)

Usage: airs gateway workspaces get [OPTIONS] <ref>

Arguments:
  <ref>  

Options:
      --output <format>  Output format: pretty, table, json
      --plane <plane>    Plane to read from: data (scoped) or admin (whole tenant)
      --quiet            Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help

Examples:
  $ airs gateway workspaces get ws-main-a-349e0e
  $ airs gateway workspaces get 16f7e90d-382a-4e78-b577-1b01eb5f8297 --plane admin --output json
```

### airs gateway workspaces list

```text
List workspaces (default: active workspaces you are scoped to)

Usage: airs gateway workspaces list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --all              Merge active + archived admin-plane reads (whole tenant, both states)
      --output <format>  Output format: pretty, table, json
      --plane <plane>    Plane to read from: data (scoped) or admin (whole tenant)
      --quiet            Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --status <status>  Filter by lifecycle state: active or archived
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help

Examples:
  $ airs gateway workspaces list
  $ airs gateway workspaces list --plane admin
  $ airs gateway workspaces list --plane admin --status archived
  $ airs gateway workspaces list --all --output json
```

### airs gateway workspaces update

```text
Update a workspace (admin plane, partial patch)

Usage: airs gateway workspaces update [OPTIONS] <ref>

Arguments:
  <ref>  

Options:
      --description <text>   New description
      --output <format>      Output format: pretty, table, json
      --force                Skip the confirmation prompt
      --quiet                Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug                Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --icon <icon>          New icon
      --name <name>          New display name
      --tenant <name>        Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
      --defaults <json>      Workspace defaults object
      --metadata <json>      Sugar for defaults.metadata (flat string map)
      --rate-limits <json>   Rate-limit policies — a JSON ARRAY of policy objects
      --usage-limits <json>  Usage-limit policies — a JSON ARRAY of policy objects
  -h, --help                 Print help

Examples:
  $ airs gateway workspaces update ws-produc-985697 --description 'Production workloads, us-east'
```
